# Minions.AI — Operational AI Voice & Front-Office Dispatch System

> Minions.AI builds autonomous, sub-1.8s AI voice dispatchers and speed-to-lead automation systems engineered co-primarily for pest control operators and real estate agencies, with full support for HVAC, plumbing, roofing, and electrical businesses.

## Core Capabilities & Performance Benchmarks
- **Voice Answering Latency**: Answers live phone lines in under 1.8 seconds (1–2 rings), 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
- **Zero Missed Revenue**: Captures $15,000 real estate commissions and $2,500+ recurring pest control agreements that would otherwise be lost to voicemail when operators are mid-showing or on routes.
- **Direct CRM & Calendar Integration**: Two-way real-time scheduling with FieldRoutes, PestPac, GorillaDesk, Follow Up Boss, ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Jobber, and Google Calendar.
- **Instant SMS Speed-to-Lead**: Automatically texts back missed calls or disconnected leads in 4 seconds to secure appointments before competitors respond.
- **Acoustic Robustness**: Noise filtering engineered for noisy job sites, power tools, highway traffic, regional accents, and urgent homeowner scenarios.
- **Deterministic Human Escalation**: Cleanly transfers complex or high-priority inquiries to owner cell phones with complete caller context briefings.

## Live Callable Phone Demo
- **Live Test Line**: +1 (346) 626-4720
- **Demo Scenarios**: Test 24/7 AI call answering, emergency triage, schedule checking, and instant CRM confirmation.

## Pricing Architecture
- **Starter Build**: $1,000 one-time build fee (Rex 24/7 Voice Dispatcher, CRM/Calendar sync, call forwarding, 14-day delivery).
- **Full Crew Build**: $2,000 one-time build fee (Rex + Zip SMS recovery + Pip web concierge + Gia reviews + Otto intake, 21-day delivery).
- **Ongoing Telephony**: Direct carrier wholesale usage via Retell AI / Twilio (~$0.08–$0.14/min) with zero markup and no mandatory monthly retainers.
